cases.source:
//@version=6
strategy("basic entry")
longCondition = close > open
if longCondition
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("history na")
prev = close[1]
longCondition = not na(prev) and close > prev
if longCondition
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("sma")
basis = ta.sma(close, 3)
if not na(basis) and close > basis
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("ema")
basis = ta.ema(close, 3)
if not na(basis) and close > basis
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("wma")
basis = ta.wma(close, 3)
if not na(basis) and close > basis
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("rsi")
value = ta.rsi(close, 3)
if not na(value) and value > 40
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("highest")
value = ta.highest(high, 3)
if not na(value) and close <= value
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("lowest")
value = ta.lowest(low, 3)
if not na(value) and close >= value
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("stdev")
dev = ta.stdev(close, 3)
if not na(dev) and dev >= 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("change")
delta = ta.change(close)
if not na(delta) and delta > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("crossover")
basis = ta.sma(close, 3)
if ta.crossover(close, basis)
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("math composition")
value = math.max(close, math.sqrt(81.0))
if value > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("modulo")
if bar_index % 2 == 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("ternary")
signal = close > open ? 1 : 0
if signal == 1
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("udf series")
bull(src) => not na(src[1]) and src > src[1]
if bull(close)
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("for loop")
float total = 0.0
for i = 0 to 2
    total += close[i]
if not na(total) and total > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("switch expression")
bool signal = switch
    close > open => true
    => false
if signal
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("time components")
if hour >= 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("request security")
remote = request.security("TEST", "D", close)
if not na(remote) and remote > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")

//@version=6
strategy("visual atr")
value = ta.atr(3)
plot(value, "ATR")
if not na(value) and value > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bar_index >= 5
    strategy.close("L")
